canonical_statement: A partially defined real-linear operator A on a real Banach space generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup on nonnegative time if and only if A is closed, its domain is dense, and for every real a > 0 the operator a I - A has a bounded two-sided inverse R satisfying ||R y|| <= a^-1 ||y||.
domain_and_universes: X : Type u with NormedAddCommGroup X, NormedSpace Real X, CompleteSpace X; A : X ->l.[Real] X; T : NNReal -> X ->L[Real] X
ordered_binders: a > 0 and R on the resolvent side
hypotheses_and_definitions: T(0) = I and T(s+t) = T(s) comp T(t)
each orbit t |-> T(t)x is continuous
the graph of A equals the strong right-derivative graph of T at zero
A.domain is dense and A.graph is closed
for every a > 0, R is a bounded two-sided inverse of a I - A
conclusion: the generation side is logically equivalent to the closed/dense/resolvent side
